_editing_note: Fees, categories and how to apply. Fees are in rupees as plain numbers so the site can compare them — do not add commas or '₹'. When fees change, update `classes` and bump `feesEffective`.
_formPdf_note: The 2025-26 form is served from the old site. Place the current PDF at public/downloads/ and update `formPdf` when a new one is issued.

tenures.name: Annual
tenures.description: One year's subscription plus the one-time admission fee.

tenures.name: 5 years
tenures.description: Five years' membership for four years' subscription, plus the one-time admission fee.
tenures._note: The membership form calls this the '5 years Subscription Advantage'. The old website's fee table instead listed a '3 Year' option at three times the annual subscription. The form is the more recent document, so it is used here; the 3-year row is preserved in `supersededOptions` below.

tenures.name: 10 years
tenures.description: Ten years' membership for seven years' subscription, plus the one-time admission fee.

tenures.name: Life
tenures.description: Twenty years' membership for fifteen years' subscription, plus the one-time admission fee.
tenures._note: The form and the old fee table agree: Life Membership runs for 20 years.

supersededOptions.name: 3 years
supersededOptions.detail: Three times the annual subscription plus the admission fee.
supersededOptions.source: Old website fee table. Not present on the 2025-26 application form.

documents: Proof of membership category — copy of Udyog / UDYAM Aadhaar
For Associate (Individual) — Aadhaar copy as ID proof
DD or cheque for the membership fee

formFields.representatives: One official representative (owner), up to two additional representatives, and an HR contact. Additional representatives are added to the chamber's WhatsApp group.
formFields.exportQuestion: Whether the unit exports, and to which countries.

approval: Applications are considered at an Executive Committee meeting and must be proposed and seconded by existing members.

benefits.title: Government notifications, monthly
benefits.detail: Copies of important notifications affecting your industry, circulated every month.

benefits.title: Certificate of Origin
benefits.detail: CMIA is authorised to issue Certificates of Origin to exporters from the region.

benefits.title: GSP issuance, fortnightly
benefits.detail: A representative of the Export Inspection Council visits from Mumbai every fortnight to issue GSP here.

benefits.title: Representation that reaches
benefits.detail: The chamber takes specific issues to local administration, the state and the centre on a member's behalf.

benefits.title: Tax help desk
benefits.detail: A help desk at the secretariat for issues related to service tax.

benefits.title: Training, as needed
benefits.detail: Training programmes organised for members according to need.

benefits.title: The chamber's rooms
benefits.detail: A seminar hall seating 80+, a board room and a closed-door meeting room at Bajaj Bhavan.

benefits.title: Buyer-seller meets and Maha Expo
benefits.detail: Buyer-seller meets, themed seminars and business visits — and Maha Expo, held once every four years.
